raw:
Agent Name: InformationVerification_Expert
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: Used brittle HTML parsing that assumed a span with id "Discography" and a single adjacent unordered list. This caused a NoneType error and, after a quick fix, still returned no items, failing to extract any albums from the page. By not iterating through the full discography section or consulting the dedicated discography/category pages, they missed the relevant 2000–2009 studio albums, leading to an incorrect basis for the final count (which should be 3).
